newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire's Mobutu to return home on Monday - aide.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu to return home on Monday - aide.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko will return home from France on Monday, a senior member of his party said on Friday.

Banza Mukalayi, deputy president of Mobutu's Popular Revolutionary Movement MPR, said it was not immediately clear whether the veteran leader would return to the capital Kinshasa or his jungle palace at Gbadolite.
"The president is expected back in Zaire on Monday," he told Reuters.
Mobutu, who seized power in a 1965 coup, had prostate cancer surgery in Switzerland last August and has spent most of his time in Europe since then, returning only for brief visits.
Tutsi-led rebels took up arms in October vowing to topple him. They hold towns and territory in the east and have been pushing steadily west and south.
